# Data.gov

> > Data.gov is the U.S. Government's centralized open data portal for discovering, accessing, and publishing federal datasets to promote transparency and evidence-based governance.

Data.gov, managed by the General Services Administration (GSA), serves as the primary platform for federal open data discovery and is complemented by the Federal Data Strategy initiative. The platform uses CKAN technology to catalog thousands of datasets from federal, state, and local agencies, supporting the government's commitment to the OPEN Government Data Act.

## Dataset Discovery & Catalogs

- [Dataset Catalog](https://catalog.data.gov/dataset): Dataset search and discovery interface for federal government open data
- [Main Catalog](https://catalog.data.gov): Main CKAN-powered catalog for discovering federal government datasets
- [Catalog Beta](https://catalog-beta.data.gov): Beta version of Data.gov's searchable dataset catalog with geographic filtering
- [Organizations Directory](https://catalog.data.gov/organization): Directory of federal, state, and local organizations publishing datasets

## Federal Data Strategy

- [Federal Data Strategy Homepage](https://strategy.data.gov): Federal Data Strategy homepage with 10-year vision for government data governance
- [2021 Action Plan](https://strategy.data.gov/2021/action-plan): 2021 implementation actions for Federal Data Strategy across agencies
- [2020 Action Plan](https://strategy.data.gov/2020/action-plan): 2020 Federal Data Strategy action plan for federal data management
- [2021 Progress Report](https://strategy.data.gov/2021/progress): 2021 progress tracking on Federal Data Strategy implementation milestones
- [2020 Progress Report](https://strategy.data.gov/2020/progress): 2020 progress report on Federal Data Strategy agency milestone completion

## Data Governance & Resources

- [Resources Portal](https://resources.data.gov): Repository of federal data governance policies, standards, and management resources
- [About Data.gov](https://data.gov/about): Information about Data.gov's mission, technology stack, and GSA governance
- [Open Government](https://data.gov/open-gov): Overview of Data.gov's open government mission and international data initiatives

## Getting Started

- [Data.gov Home](https://data.gov): Homepage for U.S. Government's open data portal and public dataset discovery
- [User Guide](https://data.gov/user-guide): Guide for accessing and using Data.gov's federal datasets and catalogs
